+name: Build and Deploy
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [main]

+        with:
+          name: app-build
+          path: dist/
+          retention-days: 7
+
+  deploy:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    needs: build
+    steps:
+      - name: Download build artifact
+        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1

+          name: app-build
+          path: dist/
+
+      - name: Verify artifact contents

parts.text:
Empty repo, no existing workflows. I'll create a workflow demonstrating artifact upload and download between jobs. Let me create `.github/workflows/build.yml`.

Key details for artifact sharing:
- Earlier job uploads with `actions/upload-artifact@v4`
- Later job has `needs: build-job` and downloads with `actions/download-artifact@v4`
- Artifact name must match. `download-artifact@v4` downloads all artifacts by default, or specific with `name`.

Let me write a clean example.
No existing workflows, so I'll create one.

input.content:
name: Build and Deploy

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Build
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist
          echo "build output for ${{ github.sha }}" > dist/app.txt

      - name: Upload build artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: app-build
          path: dist/
          retention-days: 7

  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - name: Download build artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: app-build
          path: dist/

      - name: Verify artifact contents
        run: |
          ls -la dist/
          cat dist/app.txt

parts.text:
Created `.github/workflows/build.yml`.

- `build` job uploads `dist/` as artifact `app-build` via `actions/upload-artifact`.
- `deploy` job uses `needs: build` to run after, then downloads the same-named artifact via `actions/download-artifact`.

The key requirement: the `name` must match across upload/download, and `needs:` creates the ordering. Actions are pinned to vetted SHAs (v7/v8) flagged by the version check.
